items.text: 000048 214a14d122f1cf5d0dbad3113f272de97715a2b30363a2d4ae82c34a4230b78d Minnesota Economic Outlook The economic outlook for Minnesota has weakened slightly since MMB’s November 2025 Budget and Economic Forecast.

items.label: NORMALIZATION_ARTIFACT
items.text: economy.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000440 814deed2f70046160c7e3d0eb550c9b92fca42ce338e88dc381f3b0826d252a3 These forecasts and outlooks include the macroeconomic assumptions incorporated in Minnesota’s February 2026 Budget and Economic Forecast.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000441 29646aa73c4a17505ecdec5240c33c6b6a02ab16673a7c98804a00d0c72f89f6 Council members agreed that there remains substantial uncertainty in the new administration’s policy initiatives, especially regarding trade and immigration policies.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000442 711c9618ff3cf080bb195f451110b7e8f753ea9d596033b65daf76c688bdb233 Members noted some apparent contradictions in SPGMI’s baseline forecast and generally believed that there are more downside risks than upside risks.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000443 ed5ca5092031d2f205475a581f112bb8f28a0261de73a4e231221e761cc7acbd Nonetheless, subject to considerable uncertainties about U.S.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: economic policy in this year and beyond, Council members agreed that the SPGMI baseline forecast forms a reasonable basis for the February 2026 Budget and Economic Forecast.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000444 bccb659522d20be6531c11c6823bc9e0fa5ca2fac53b872b5ee2ab9c8351cae9 Council members noted mixed signals about the strength of the national labor market.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000445 7f272f6ae32aeef04ad6e46def0b991619db83612e227da607aefda7f9d84591 They note inconsistencies between the revised labor data for 2025, showing low monthly growth in payrolls, and the January 2026 payroll growth estimate released by the BLS this month.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000446 d333e6891d0ef59ffe43e6f8986edc8d348fcd001b4698b3e4a9e5ffb9689f99 Members noted that the private sector is providing all the payroll growth as public-sector employment continues to decline.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000447 3cf3f2cfdd79a9a7c37d61646250809e5fdf1868620cdd8ceeb160f011c187e8 The majority of payroll growth is in healthcare and social services, and while manufacturing payrolls had a small upward change in January, year-over-year, manufacturing employment is lower.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000448 3ec5d33b1809e9084b1a4a93678c49ba885f894cb2acd773489844c0064fadb2 Some members also noted that the administration’s immigration policies likely affect hiring in several sectors (e.g., hospitality, food service, and construction) and that the forecast should better incorporate immigration uncertainty.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000449 505b2c6ec34e2d28c1b4ab4db546cde967fc20000b919d757698a9193300edd0 Some council members believe that the effects of AI adoption present uncertain upside risks for labor productivity but may present downside risks if AI replaces, rather than augments, labor.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000450 300f4c734885469b17c19ba132870b5af86bfcfc29c492f41c474f2a7dd8811b Overall, AI investment and adoption provide reasons for optimism in the long-term outlook.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000451 f0ed1eb95989d3f60f39107a205dfed676f0884b783bda634027772876c7b205 Council members noted that inflation in the major indexes has fallen substantially in the past few years.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000452 f3abdcb66066eb6539e4583cbf7fe268185d5e500c346577180de6d0bf935502 They cautioned that there may be a downward bias in the current CPI data because of missed October 2025 data collection during the federal shutdown; this bias may persist until CPI data are revised later this year.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000453 faea0d1a9340e9e0b29c2045428b0b537e40612395f1980f52fa779c5ed7ec1e It was also noted that goods inflation may be reemerging, possibly linked to tariffs.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000454 a35b82ec5845b39a3353468a6007cf9136fb07572b6e8c4c5c0ffe969a997446 SPGMI’s forecasts for declines in the stock market (S&P 500 index) and corporate profits were seen as reasonable as general indicators of future conditions rather than as forecasts of a downturn at a particular point in time.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000455 e25cfadd0a30665e5f317f398c036a6ac57b8319c53a939c7e8a3707b60cf628 Members agreed that the stock market may be “overvalued” by conventional measures and a correction in the near-term is plausible, but the timing and magnitude are uncertain.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000456 7c96a78f205ca3ebc3f88a9bf8e652ff1e8bb4176c38e8e26a9dc00fbfc689df A downward correction in equities and corporate profits could affect the forecast for personal consumption by decreasing wealth and dividend income of higher-income households, who account for a disproportionate share of consumption expenditures.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000457 9870000970e1f6518b6322309dfb7915df1bf2bb60e93297384982cc050b73e6 40 Budget & Economic Forecast February 2026 Council members identified several challenges for the Minnesota economy and were generally more pessimistic about the State’s economy than the national one.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000458 91512b466df0ae27715a9ccc52fb0bbb52825f8e3ce61ac99e3f8667dc0e8063 Agriculture was seen as a vulnerability due to lower forecasts of farm income and lower commodity prices, particularly in corn and soybeans.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000459 73813309ed451e3256687034cb5088c56e733f0daf2ebcbb7221333b4506dd6f The recent increase in the State’s unemployment rate to 4.1 percent in December 2025, up from 3.0 percent a year earlier, may signal weakness in hiring.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000460 bc7547a9a67d881c73d867c9c9f0f17e7150aa1c018b64248c0a8353bf0a0268 Tourism and retail in some regions of the state may be at risk because of fewer foreign visitors, particularly from Canada.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000461 579fb43d079132c05ebf52035deab9857dd4e187bf4edbb961ae25e2bf1e1649 Finally, the recent federal immigration actions (“Metro Surge”) may have adversely affected both retail sales and employment in the Twin Cities metro area, though data to assess the extent of these effects will not be available for many months.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000462 f55ccd067755090c95fad9c247a1454f6333bd35b0609d8697a0e8456cefc1fc In its February forecast, SPGMI provided a baseline forecast with both optimistic and pessimistic scenarios.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000463 13e4286bbada855a29b5b85d538d53aee264400b62dd02f661b2a8f1c9874945 They assigned a 50 percent probability to the baseline scenario, and 25 percent each to the optimistic and pessimistic scenarios.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000464 bda5af11ab3db38dd419350531be65d6fed3b4ff9b66ec71b14ecf887377dd87 Council members were surveyed anonymously about the probabilities they would assign to each of the three scenarios and their main upside and downside risks.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000465 638340deb1106ce35214178b394d2c74789073637303611d9b07b61170362568 The mean probability that members assigned to the baseline scenario was 53.3 percent.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000466 1dacb5fd7b9501025b0e579866e48c4d2242f33be37a5217eb42df548a6330af Their mean probabilities were 20.8 percent for the optimistic scenario and 25.8 percent for the pessimistic scenario.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000467 c8ffea2fd75b9bb705c1a98dc809260d15fb3309c8714b31f2a15a2cfa753818 For upside risks, Council members saw AI boosts to productivity and investment, “reshoring” of manufacturing, lower effective tariffs, and a stronger global economy as likely upside risks.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000468 ab32aa495ef21adb6aaffaddf5b318e1f0a54fb93d480bfdafe84d61bcf9357d They identified trade policy uncertainty causing businesses to defer investment, immigration enforcement activities' effects on labor markets, a substantial downturn in equity prices, and the possibility of an “AI bubble” bursting as possible downside risks.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000469 ef86509cbc52d94e7fad41d7e47439d0f636bc5ef0baec36562a56d8f1352d17 Council members can envision a variety of possible shocks that, separately or in combination, could throw the national and state economies off their forecasted paths.

items.label: WORD_SPLIT_OCR
items.text: 000470 1090ebdcca3fb022704f7a3d3e0dd9987db927d4d46f443ca2f1a93af48ca585 Council members also differentiated between short-run and long-run forecast risks and noted that the short-run risks may be more important over the budget planning horizon.
